newsitem.title: USA: CME to open Dow Jones Taiwan stock futures Jan 8.
newsitem.headline: CME to open Dow Jones Taiwan stock futures Jan 8.

text.p: The Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME) will start electronic trading January 8 in futures and futures-options on the Dow Jones Taiwan Stock Index.
The CME, in a statement issued late Friday, said it would open trading at 1900 CST Wednesday (0100 GMT Thursday) in the products on GLOBEX after-hours electronic trading only.

The new futures will be the first Asian product under CME's effort to tap into instruments tied to emerging markets. The contract marks the first time CME has offered a product exclusively on GLOBEX and not in the trading pit, a CME spokeswoman said Monday.
The Dow Jones Taiwan Stock Index is a capitalization weighted, broad-based index of 117 stocks listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange.
The Pacific Stock Exchange has said it would start trading options on the cash index January 9. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
